sloka: हितानुबन्धमालोच्य कार्याकार्यमिहात्मनः ।राजा सहार्थतत्त्वज्ञैः सचिवैः स हि जीवति ।। ६.६३.१३ ।।
transliteration: hitānubandhamālocya kāryākāryamihātmanaḥ ।rājā sahārthatattvajñaiḥ sacivaiḥ sa hi jīvati ।। 6.63.13 ।।

translations.english: "That king who knows the reality of things and makes decisions in consultation with his ministers, who make their living with their intelligence will live happily."
translations.hindi: “ “इक डे इस महाबलवान ने उत्पन्न होते ही भूख से विकल हो, बहुत से हजारों जोर्वो को खा डाला था
